scope: Actual original promise-chain/raw/internal wrapper behavior under finite inert callback schedules. This does not establish native public cross-tab concurrency or cancellation timing.

cases.name: FIFO callback rejection never poisons its successor
independent tab starts and finishes while another tab waits
synchronous throw releases even the first tail
synchronous throw between two held operations releases successor
an already rejected waiter still enters and releases in order
an already resolved waiter still enters and releases in order
callback may enqueue same-tab work without awaiting it
forget preserves current owner and all waiters
raw and internal calls share one queue including skip
raw failure allows queued internal callback
late raw acknowledgement after forget retains queue order
serial operations release their queue while raw tab state survives
